description: This source file defines the RetrieveFeaturePropertyStrategy class, which implements the handling of the RetrieveFeatureProperty command within a persistent actor strategy. It involves extracting feature properties from a Thing object and generating appropriate results or errors based on the presence of features and properties.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles the RetrieveFeatureProperty command, extending AbstractThingCommandStrategy, and providing logic to extract feature properties from a Thing for querying.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic: extracts the feature from the Thing, and then retrieves the feature property, returning a Result with either the property data or an error.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts the specified feature from the Thing, throwing if not found.

methods.name: getRetrieveFeaturePropertyResult
methods.description: Creates a Result containing the feature property, or an error if not found.

methods.name: getRetrieveFeaturePropertyResult
methods.description: Generates a Result wrapping the feature property value as a response, handling missing property errors.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag, if any, based on the previous Thing entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag from the new entity, based on the feature's property.
